scientific_integrity: The stated rare-count and conditional-age limits are supported by an analytic reflection-kernel/renewal argument; finite quadrature is corroborative, not proof. No independent audit or certification has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Identical one-dimensional Brownian particles with simultaneous complete reset at the first +L hit, fixed positive L and D, N>=3 and N tending to infinity. Counts instantaneous positions strictly below -L. The existing exact finite-N stationary joint law contains the necessary information, and originality of its sharp endpoint asymptotics remains subject to external evaluation.
title: Logarithmic mirror-threshold occupations in a first-passage resetting Brownian gas
